subject: Developer Office Hours: Reducing Inference Cost — RSVP, UTM & Failover Plan
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@cloudforge.com>, Anna Li <anna@acmeai.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Developer Office Hours: Reducing Inference Cost — initial plan

Hi team,

Drafting the inbound invite for our May 24 Developer Office Hours focused on inference cost optimizations. Goal: 250 RSVPs with 120 live attendees, biasing to platform engineers and infra-focused PMs. Please review the plan below and the attached artifacts (invite_variants_v2.docx + utm_mapping_sheet.csv).

High level:
- Audience: engineers + SREs at mid-market / growth SaaS (APAC & US rounds)
- CTA: RSVP -> calendar add -> reminder sequence (48h, 4h, 30m)
- Tracking: segmented UTM per persona and channel; fallback link if capacity hit

Key asks for this thread:
1) Marissa: finalize subject + 2 hero variants (technical & product).
2) Kimberly: confirm target lists + suppression window for recent webinar sends.
3) Vivek: provide tracking & failover URLs; we need capacity fallback routing (page -> waitlist + on-demand recording).

Failover plan (brief):
- Primary: Zoom registration link with 3k capacity; if registration forms show >2k in 24h window, switch promoted link to: /waitlist?utm_campaign=dev-hours-fallback
- On event day: send recording link to waitlist within 24 hours; mark attendees who convert as high-quality leads for SDR follow-up.

Attachments included: invite_variants_v2.docx, utm_mapping_sheet.csv, scheduling_grid.ics

Thanks — please reply with edits inline.

—
Michael Grant
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Developer Office Hours: Reducing Inference Cost — initial plan

On 2027-05-02 09:15, Michael Grant wrote:
> Drafting the inbound invite for our May 24 Developer Office Hours focused on inference cost optimizations.

All good — I sketched two subject lines and three short openers in the doc. Quick notes:
- Subject options: "How top teams cut inference cost 2-5x (live demo)" OR "Live: Reduce LLM inference cost — tactics & tradeoffs". I recommend the second for slightly broader appeal.
- Keep the technical variant heavy on examples (KV cache, batching, quantization profiles). The product-angle should highlight ROI and latency SLOs.
- For RSVP cadence: in addition to the existing reminders, add a “1-week pre” message with a single quick tip to increase perceived value.

Edits are in invite_variants_v2.docx. I also added a short paragraph we can A/B test in the intro: a 3-bullet checklist for infra owners.

—Marissa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Developer Office Hours: Reducing Inference Cost — target lists & suppression

Thanks — I exported the target lists and attached the UTM mapping sheet (utm_mapping_sheet.csv). Notes:
- Primary sends (US): product infra + SRE lists from Q1 webinar engaged (open rate > 28%). Count ~9,200 unique.
- Secondary sends (APAC): timezone windows for APAC engineering hubs, segments likely ~1,800.
- Suppress: anyone who attended the "LLM serving deep dive" in last 90 days and anyone who clicked the last 3 promotional links.

Proposed cadence per segment:
- Primary: Invite, 7-day reminder, 48h, 4h, 30m.
- Secondary: Invite, 48h, 4h.

Attachments: utm_mapping_sheet.csv (contains per-channel UTM parameters and the fallback UTM for waitlist).

Kimberly

Subject: Re: Developer Office Hours: Reducing Inference Cost — CloudForge support + tracking

Thanks for the invite plan — CloudForge happy to co-promote. Two quick confirmations from our side:
1) UTM params: we'll append utm_source=cloudforge, utm_medium=partner-email, utm_campaign=dev-hours-0524. We'll use the fallback utm_campaign=dev-hours-fallback if you flip the promoted link to the waitlist.
2) Tracking pixel: we can add the 1x1 tracking pixel on the confirmation page if you want partner attribution in our dashboard. Send tracking_setup_screenshot.png for our ops team and we'll validate.

We also have a community slack announcement window Tues/Thurs mornings — suggest we post Thu May 20 to capture late registrants.

Subject: RE: Developer Office Hours: Finalized RSVP + failover links

Perfect — locking this down. Final decisions:
- Subject copy: "Live: Reduce LLM inference cost — tactics & tradeoffs" (Marissa suggestion).
- Variants: technical + product, with the checklist A/B test in the opening paragraph.
- UTM mapping: use Kimberly's sheet + add cloudforge partner utm_source and fallback utm_campaign for waitlist.
- Capacity failover: promoted redirect to /waitlist?utm_campaign=dev-hours-fallback; auto-email the recording within 24h.
- Reminders: Primary cadence (Invite, 7d, 48h, 4h, 30m).

Ops owner actions by EOD Monday (2027-05-10):
- Vivek: publish tracking and provide final tracking URLs (include partner pixel agreement).
- Kimberly: finalize export lists and load to SendGrid suppressions.
- Marissa: finalize variants in doc and send the creative to design.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync Friday to confirm creative and links. If any objections, reply-all.

Thanks — I added scheduling_grid.ics to the thread and moved the Drive folder link to the related_links above.
